framework: vanilla HTML with Apache SSI, Bootstrap 5.3.3 JavaScript, static generators, and fingerprinted assets

signals.fonts: Remote Instrument Serif, Lexend, Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans, Geist, Cormorant Garamond, and DM Serif references are inconsistent across routes; no local @font-face source existed at scan time.
signals.palette: Existing warm paper, forest green, teal, cyan, brown, slate, and ink custom properties conflict across global and page stylesheets.
signals.motion: No dedicated motion library; the project is motion-cut.
signals.spacing: Multiple unrelated scales; the locked system introduces one four-point named scale.
signals.cssPayload: 245 of 250 sitemapped routes exceed the 50 KiB gzip budget; full Bootstrap is present on all 250 routes.
signals.sharedCss: Shared nav and footer inline CSS is repeated across SSI-expanded routes; sensei-sandy-logo-global.css owns substantially more than logo rules.
